title: AI Solutions Analyst
description:
**Your role**
=============


Finance \- Financial Planning \& Analysis \- P1 \- IND**What you'll be doing**
========================

**Job Description**

**Role: AI Solutions Analyst – Process Excellence and Intelligence**

**Purpose of the Role**


We are looking for an AI Solutions Analyst to support the Process Excellence and Intelligence team in building AI agents, automations, and reporting solutions that reduce manual effort across FP\&A, Sales Compensation, Power BI, Salesforce, and recurring operational processes.


The role will focus on identifying repetitive manual activities, converting them into AI\-assisted or fully automated workflows, and building secure, scalable solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Chat GPT, Power Platform, Python, Excel automation, Power BI, Salesforce, and related tools.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build AI agents for recurring business processes.
* Automate manual FP\&A and Sales Compensation tasks using **Python, Power Automate, Excel macros, Office Scripts, and APIs**.
* Create agents that can answer questions from SharePoint files, Excel trackers, policy documents, process SOPs, and reporting repositories.
* Develop workflows for recurring reports, stakeholder reminders, data validation, approval routing, and exception tracking.
* Integrate agents and automations with **Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, Salesforce, and other business systems**.
* Build validation scripts for sales compensation calculations, quota attainment checks, payout exception checks, and data reconciliation.
* Support Power BI and Salesforce report enhancement by automating data preparation and issue tracking.
* Design human\-in\-the\-loop approvals for sensitive outputs such as compensation calculations, financial commentary, or stakeholder communications.
* Document processes, automation logic, data lineage, controls, and support procedures.
* Track automation benefits including manual hours saved, error reduction, cycle\-time improvement, and adoption.

**Required Skills**

* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Copilot Studio**, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Power Platform.
* Strong Python skills, especially **Pandas, openpyxl, Excel file handling, data validation, and automation**.
* Strong Excel skills including formulas, Power Query, macros/VBA, and data modelling.
* Experience with APIs, JSON, REST services, and connectors.
* Experience working with Power BI datasets, reports, refreshes, or dataflows.
* Understanding of Salesforce data objects, reports, dashboards, or integrations.
* Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and AI output validation.
* Ability to translate business requirements into automation workflows.
* Good documentation and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with finance, FP\&A, sales operations, or sales compensation processes.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Graph API.
* Experience with Dataverse or SQL.
* Familiarity with Azure AI, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, or Azure OpenAI.
* Exposure to RPA or UI automation.
* Understanding of governance, DLP, security roles, and access controls.
* Data Science, Statistics knowledge will be added advantage.

================

title: Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: Data Engineer**

**Job Title: Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer**


**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering and data science. In this role, you will build and own the data infrastructure that powers analytics and machine learning workflows — ensuring data is accurate, performant, and ready for insight. You will work closely with data science, engineering, and business teams to deliver production\-grade solutions that drive real decisions.


**What You'll Bring**


You have 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or an equivalent technical role, with a track record of owning outcomes rather than just completing tasks.


On the technical side, you bring strong, hands\-on SQL skills and deep Snowflake experience — including performance tuning, warehouse management, and a genuine awareness of cost implications. You are comfortable with Python for data work, including pandas, NumPy, scripting, and writing tests. You have built and maintained data accuracy and quality frameworks, not just flagged issues.


You also have a solid foundation in statistics — distributions, sampling, hypothesis testing, regression, and confidence intervals — and a working knowledge of the data science workflow: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics. You don't need to be a full ML engineer, but you understand the pipeline well enough to support and improve it.


**What We Value**


Beyond technical depth, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, and brings a quality mindset to everything they ship. If something looks off in the data, you investigate it. If a process can be improved, you improve it.

Data Science Skills: • Python, R, Deep Learning Neural Networks • Traffic Analysis using Computer Vision and AI. • Exposure to Azure AI or AWS Machine Learning Modules a plus. • Ability to write SQL queries as well as logical scripts. Nice to have skills: • OpenCV • Caffe2 • Azure Custom Vision • YOLO3 Minimum Qualifications: • Graduate degree (M Tech or PhD) with a specialization on computer vision, machine learning, data analysis is strongly preferred. • 3\+ years of related experience\- including delivering Predictive Analytics/Custom Vision solutions. • Some experience with Analytics/Business Intelligence tools such as Qlik, Birst, Tableau, Power BI, Spotfire, or comparable products. • Ability to create data visualizations and transform concepts into fully realized production applications. • Ability to learn the business and develop relationships that enhance the value of the Business Technology (IT). • Ability to manipulate SQL queries Skills \& Abilities: Intermediate experience with statistical computing and programming languages (ex: R, Python, Java, Scala, etc.) is required. Intermediate analytical, quantitative, and statistical skills. Intermediate knowledge of data cleansing, validation and general quality control principles. title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Job Description**

iROHUB Infotech is hiring a Data Science Trainer cum Developer who has strong analytical skills and a passion for teaching. The role involves training students in data science concepts while also working on real\-time data\-driven projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct Data Science training sessions for students
* Teach Python for Data Science, Statistics, and Machine Learning concepts
* Mentor students in academic and real\-time projects
* Guide students in data analysis, model building, and deployment
* Prepare training materials, assignments, and assessments
* Review student performance and provide constructive feedback
* Work on internal or client\-based data science projects
* Coordinate with academic and placement teams

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn
* Experience with Machine Learning algorithms
* Knowledge of SQL and databases
* Basics of Deep Learning is an added advantage
* Experience with tools like Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab
* Good communication and mentoring skills

**Note: We are looking for candidates who are interested in a trainer/teaching role only. This position is focused on training and mentoring students, not on project\-based or development work. Candidates interested exclusively in project roles are requested not to apply.**

**Interested candidates kindly WhatsApp your resume to 90720 66363**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Data science: 1 year (Required)
* Mentoring: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
